title: Cannot delete a program event when only one event exists in the program
description: When a program contains only one event, the user is unable to delete it, and an error message is displayed. However, the program can be edited to add more events.
steps: Create a new program with two lighting events. (e.g., 'Program D' with 'Sunrise' and 'Sunset' events).
Navigate back to the program list and select 'Program D' to edit it.
Tap the trash can icon next to the 'Sunset' event.
Observe the 'Unable to Delete' dialog box appears, stating 'Cannot delete when only one schedule event exists'.
Tap the trash can icon next to the 'Sunrise' event.
Observe the same 'Unable to Delete' dialog box appears.
actual: When attempting to delete a program event that is the only event remaining in a program, a dialog box appears stating 'Unable to Delete: Cannot delete when only one schedule event exists'. The event is not deleted.
expected: The user should be able to delete any event within a program, regardless of how many other events are present. If there is only one event, it should be deletable, or the UI should prevent the creation of programs with zero events.
